definitions: A place where a road, path, or other course changes direction; a bend or corner.
The act or process of changing direction or position.
The act or process of shaping wood or metal on a lathe.
The material removed during the process of turning on a lathe; shavings.
examples: Take the next turning on the left.
The turning of the key unlocked the door.
There were metal turnings all over the floor.
